patch.value: Recursive language models use pm as environment and ledger
Typed complete reads; durable atomic budgets; crash resume and replay; honest public tracker evaluation; npm and Bun release gates pass at 100 percent coverage.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Companion specification: pm-cli-website-y3xy. Read-only reference; implementation and all evidence belong to this package. Plan: certified environment, SDK ledger, atomic reservations and digest resume, bounded adapters and commands, measured local eval, full fleet gates. No agents, publication or remote writes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 4: verified the existing head and four unresolved findings. Reusing command, ledger and evaluation features for a package-wide sweep of environment filters, CLI operands, portable privacy needles and marker-based document replacement. No new live inference will run; the measured round-3 artifact remains unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round-4 sweep changes: shared case-insensitive Git filtering now covers identity auditing, verified eval copying and its fixture; coverage removes mixed-case runner variables; audit and packed consumers remove every casing of npm script policy and userconfig before setting one isolated config. All command positional/string operands reject blanks; all three numeric flags require unsigned decimal safe integers and existing settings bounds. Privacy handles shallow roots, Windows drive/UNC casing, separators and trailing separators; identity checks also cover mixed-case backslash home paths. The offline report uses unique ordered markers, validates before writes, and removes obsolete prose-based migration edits. Saved live measurements are unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Additional whole-package operand sweep: the coverage, docstring and identity script CLIs now share a nonblank optional repository-root validator, preventing empty paths from silently selecting the current checkout. Regression executes all three entry points with empty and whitespace-only operands. The first coverage run identified an unreachable separator branch, now removed; the mixed-case coverage regression permits c8 to re-establish its own uppercase instrumentation variable while proving inherited variants are absent.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The environment sweep also found the recovery worker blanking only the canonical test-context key. It now removes every spelling while preserving coverage inheritance; coverage uses the same helper. Real Git policy fixtures and packed consumers now discard inherited Git overrides too. Windows privacy additionally covers forward-slash UNC roots and JSON-escaped path names. A proof run exposed that reverting the quality-root guard could invoke the full coverage gate recursively; the regression now checks the identity entry first to fail immediately under that revert.

New proofs cover Git/npm/coverage/recovery environment casing, numeric/string/root CLI operands, root and Windows privacy, identity path matching and marker replacement.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Commit-boundary identity validation found a false positive: the matcher interpreted the documentation label numeric/string/root as an absolute home path. The push command ran after the failed check because the command sequence did not stop on failure; head 8fdc7a7 was pushed. Preparing a boundary-aware matcher and a real-Git regression preserving relative labels while rejecting absolute home prefixes. Existing history remains append-only. The one-push instruction requires an explicit exception before any corrective push.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Correction evidence: the real-Git regression accepts repository-relative labels and still rejects an absolute home prefix. Removing only the new path boundary fails that regression; node test/revert.ts passed 36/36 behavioral mutations and restored every source byte. CI on pushed head 8fdc7a7 failed only the identity/privacy step in both matrix jobs; CodeQL passed. The correction audits the unchanged append-only history successfully. Re-running both complete release checks before a local correction commit; a second push remains unauthorized.

value.author: codex-agent
